text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Presented by Tracen Academy! The "Special 
Hero Show" begins now~!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! It's the monster Windy-chan~! 
*drooool*~~!!

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! I am the phantom, Dangerous 
Beauty!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the super villains who will change 
the world! Worldwide Windy-y-y!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Wah! So scaaary~!

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
Come along, kids. Walk the path of 
villainy with us, and the world is your 
playground! All three meals a day will be 
sn~acks!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text:
All the juice I can drink! And I don't 
have to eat any veggies at aaall!
I won't let the world come to that! Hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Champion of justice and friend to all good 
kids, Justice Biko is here!

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I am Dr. Tachyon, here to support her. I'm 
always open to cooperation on my 
experiments!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Justice Biko! Doctor Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
"If you eat only sweets, you're gonna get 
cavities! I'll crush your evil ambitions!"

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! As long as you brush your teeth 
properly, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan will teach you the proper way 
to polish it~!"

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Guh, what a polite villain...! Still, you 
ought to eat a well-balanced diet!!

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely, Justice Biko. To crush evil, 
we have no choice but to use that."

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the "Justice Smoke"! With the 
smoke billowing from this device, it'll 
instantly rob your opponent of their 
vision!

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I shall give you these special goggles. 
Now, launch a sneak attack to your heart's 
content, Justice Biko!!"

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
All right, Justice Kick from behind! 
...Wait, isn't that totally unfair!?

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is for justice too. Besides... inside 
the smoke, no one can see.

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooah! I can hear the devil 
whispering! I won't let it beat me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Do your best~, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text: Tachyon seems the most like a villain...

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
Well, the kids are having fun, so it's all 
good♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Justice Biko upheld justice, inspiring 
the children with her heroic figure!
